WinDV 2.2.2 cleans up after older versions when you upgrade with the installer.

## Download

- **WinDV-2.2.2-x64-Setup.exe**: the installer for 64-bit Windows (almost every PC).
- **WinDV-2.2.2-x64-portable.zip**: the same app without installing. Unzip anywhere and run `WinDV.exe`.
- **WinDV-2.2.2-x86-Setup.exe** and **WinDV-2.2.2-x86-portable.zip**: the same for 32-bit Windows.

Requires Windows 10 or 11. Your settings from earlier versions (or the original WinDV) carry over.

## What's new

- **Upgrades remove files that are no longer used**: WinDV 2.2.0 and earlier shipped their own copy of the .NET runtime. Installing 2.2.1 over them left about 110 MB of those files behind. The 2.2.2 installer removes them. Your settings are not affected.

The app itself is the same as in 2.2.1.
